recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-32494; if Jira metadata is curated separately, the PractitionerRole related-artifact label could be reviewed.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5. The Jira summary asked for the identifier search parameter to also search qualification.identifier, and the final resolution specifically said to include Practitioner.qualification.identifier.
initial_application: Commit f9f9a8148e291798c2b79a7d132c09e0ef18953f applied FHIR-32494 by changing source/practitioner/bundle-Practitioner-search-params.xml so Practitioner-identifier searches Practitioner.identifier | Practitioner.qualification.identifier. Current source retains that expression.
additional_context: The Jira related-artifact metadata lists PractitionerRole, but the related URL points to practitioner.html and the resolution text names Practitioner. PractitionerRole remains an active resource with PractitionerRole.identifier and specialty text that points qualifications to Practitioner.qualification, but it has no PractitionerRole.qualification.identifier element. Related FHIR-32493, duplicate FHIR-36680, and later FHIR-36681 all support the Practitioner identifier interpretation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the Practitioner search parameter already satisfies the final resolution and adding a PractitionerRole qualification identifier expression would target a nonexistent element.

evidence_items.learned: The final resolution targets Practitioner.qualification.identifier even though the related-artifact metadata lists PractitionerRole.
